x-offline-lease-policy.finalizeIntegrityRule: reassemble the persisted chunk bytes in chunkNumber order, compute SHA-256 again, and require exact equality with the immutable init sha256, finalize sha256, persisted-object sha256, expectedSize, and durably readable stored-object size before creating an attachment
x-offline-lease-policy.scanRule: finalize always creates an unbound attachment and may return pending, clean, rejected, or unavailable; readyToBind is true only for clean, mutable metadata observations may advance pending or unavailable to clean or rejected, and bind fails closed until clean
x-offline-lease-policy.bindingRenewRule: leaseGeneration starts at 1 and increments by exactly one only after the prior unclaimed reservation expires; first bind and renewal compare expectedVersion to the current aggregate version, return responseVersion=expectedVersion+1, keep the same bindingId and tuple on renewal, use monotonic server-observed time, and never reopen a claimed binding
x-offline-lease-policy.commitRule: the submission commit freezes account, actor, project, clientSubmissionId, intent, and targetQaItemId; inside one transaction it validates every attachment and reservation before mutating any, atomically re-reads clean scan, readyToBind, durable blob readability, current attachment version, current lease generation, reservation time and expiry, then claims every listed clientAttachmentId or claims none

x-occurrence-metadata-policy.sourceRule: the App may submit only legally available device, QA version, session, build, network, and orientation metadata; project, observed time, device/OS, tested resource version, and git SHA use their typed occurrence fields rather than arbitrary environment keys
x-occurrence-metadata-policy.referenceRule: a non-null buildId is a server entity reference and must resolve through a typed fact to the same account, project, and resulting Bug before create or append commits; testSessionId is an opaque App-generated correlation identifier and is never dereferenced as server authority
x-occurrence-metadata-policy.sensitiveFieldRule: reject unknown keys, credentials, tokens, account identifiers, player coordinates, arbitrary Unity state, nested objects, and free-form blobs; custom game context belongs only in the bounded redacted Poco qa.snapshot contract

x-audit-projection-policy.projectionRule: native App audit and SSE projections are server-built from typed durable facts and expose only the enumerated bounded fields; they never echo a durable raw event payload
x-audit-projection-policy.referenceRule: every projected UUID payload reference and aggregate identity is bound by a typed server fact to the same account/project and owning Bug; a syntactically valid UUID is never sufficient authority
x-audit-projection-policy.authorityRule: relay and build sources cannot emit Bug or Verification actions, non-null Bug transitions, or human acceptance/verification/closure statuses; any Bug transition is a QA Hub user action, every projected Verification result or human authority status requires a typed same-account/project/Bug assigned-verifier result proof, and closure additionally requires that proof to be passed and close-authorized
x-audit-projection-policy.forbiddenContentRule: never expose request or response bodies, Authorization or Cookie values, credentials, notification tokens, local paths, raw attachment bytes, arbitrary nested objects, or unredacted account data
